$comment: Generated by spec/test-vectors/generate.ts (bun run vectors). Do not edit.

format.replay: for each case build one client with `client`, then for each call make `request`; serve the exchanges' responses in order, assert each request the client sends equals the exchange's request, then compare payments, sleepsMs, outcome and spentAfter
format.headerNames: lowercase; HTTP header names are case-insensitive. Request headers list every header the client sent
format.clock: the client's clock starts at clockStart and advances only by the client's own sleeps
format.outcome: {type: response, status, body} when the client returned a response; {type: error, code, reason?} when it raised (reason is the policy or check detail, when there is one)
format.payments: what the payer was asked to pay, in order (centavos)
format.redirects: url and redirected on a response describe a redirect the transport already followed

cases.description: a 200 passes through untouched; nothing is paid
a 402 without PAYMENT-REQUIRED is not an x402 challenge: returned as is, nothing paid
402 challenge, the payer pays the Pix charge, the retry carries PAYMENT-SIGNATURE and gets 200
after paying, the server answers settlement_pending twice: first with Retry-After: 2 (wait max(2000, backoff 500)), then without it (wait backoff 1000); the third retry succeeds
the server refuses the paid retry with charge_expired: the client stops with that code
the caller resends a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE from an earlier request (resume); the server says the charge was already used; nothing is paid
a refusal whose errorReason is not a p-x402 code ends as payment_rejected
the charge (500) is above maxPerRequest (400): refused before paying, no retry
maxTotal 800: the first 500 is paid; a second 500 would make 1000, so it is refused before paying
allowedOrigins does not include the request origin: refused before paying
the transport followed a redirect to another origin, which answered 402: the client refuses to pay
a 402 reached through any followed redirect is refused, even on the same origin
the charge is for another resource than the one requested: refused before paying
no option is a valid p-x402 Pix option: no_supported_requirements, nothing paid
the BR Code asks for R$ 50.00 while the requirements say 500 centavos: refused before paying
